title: Bathing Enclosure — Yasnaya Polyana
visualBrief: Complete roofless wattle bathing enclosure on timber piles: four privacy screens with exposed upper/lower stakes, real shore-side short-end doorway and open timber leaf, narrow inner perimeter deck, flat bank landing, seven supported approach steps, braces and bathing ladder. Original pond remains visible through the genuinely open center and roof. Reuse shared thatch and wood_plain graphs with original geometry, no copied photo pixels. Body size, facing, concealed interior, underwater pile depth and reconstructed approach remain approximate.

sourceFacts.horizontalBasis: Named bathing point node/302670091 (Заброшенная купальня), anchor [37.52922177314758,54.07446706598759]. A.Savin’s viewed pond photograph has public camera coordinates 10.67m from this point and 171.32m from the rejected bank-side way/676929139. Camera position establishes vicinity only. No building footprint supplies scale or heading here. The 7.4x4.8m enclosure and northeast long axis are photo-led approximations, oriented with a bank-facing southwest short-end entrance. Keep the unrelated bank-side building and all other native buildings.

Native pond 208.23155921915782m; model water -1.4285852032043636m and deck -1.0285852032043636m. Preserve the original DEM samples and native water/road geometry.
